name: holoviews-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is HoloViews, a Python library for building data visualizations by annotating
data with dimensions and composing elements into containers that render with Bokeh, Matplotlib or Plotly.
Its core package defines dimensioned objects, elements, the HoloMap and DynamicMap containers, layouts and
overlays, and the Dataset data layer with its pluggable data interfaces; its stream system lets DynamicMaps
and other subscribers respond to events.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this part of the repository.
Everything in scope is HoloViews' core package and its stream system: the holoviews/core/ package (dimensions and dimensioned objects, elements, the HoloMap, DynamicMap, Layout, Overlay and other containers, the Dataset data layer and its data interfaces, accessors such as iloc, apply and redim, the options system, operations, archiving and I/O, sheet coordinates and bounding regions, pretty-printing and the core utilities) and holoviews/streams.py (streams, their subscribers and lifecycle, and the predefined stream classes), together with the module, class and function docstrings of those modules and the user-guide pages under doc/user_guide/ that cover them: Annotating_Data.rst, Applying_Customizations.rst, Building_Composite_Objects.rst, Composing_Elements.rst, Continuous_Coordinates.rst, Custom_Interactivity.rst, Data_Pipelines.rst, Dimensioned_Containers.rst, Exporting_and_Archiving.rst, Geometry_Data.rst, Gridded_Datasets.rst,
